subject: StellarPay integration: staggered cutover thresholds & SDK checklist

Subject: StellarPay: preliminary checklist + timeline for integration

Thanks Kimberly —

Quick intro: we're the StellarPay platform team (payments + payouts). We're moving from VendorX endpoints to Redwood over Q4 and want a low-risk cutover plan. High-level asks:

- A minimal SDK install + example flow we can run in staging.
- Recommended retry/timeouts and backoff for our 3s median latency workloads.
- Guidance on phased traffic migration (prefix-based routing vs percentage cutover).
- Any rate-limit signals we should watch for (headers, status codes).

Attached is our current migration matrix and a short RfE for compliance. Can your team put together a short runbook and a minimal code sample we can hand to PlatformOps?

Thanks,
Liam
Liam Brooks

liam.brooks@stellarpay.com

Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 08:33:00 -0800
Subject: Re: StellarPay: preliminary checklist + timeline for integration

Adding a few operational knobs to Kimberly's plan.

Cutover escalation rules (operational):
- Health calc window: 5m sliding window, check p50/p95 latency and 5xx rate
- Soft threshold: p95 > 2.5s or 5xx > 1% for 5m -> pause traffic ramp and notify on-call
- Hard threshold: p95 > 5s or 5xx > 3% for 2m -> immediate rollback to prior endpoint + postmortem

Rate limiting behavior to implement on your side:
- Respect 429 with Retry-After; do not retry more than twice per request when advised
- Implement client-side token bucket for spikes (burst size = 2x average QPS)
- Backpressure: if server returns 503 consistently, reduce inbound throttle at your edge (we can share a tuning script)

For observability: we'll provide a temporary dashboard with token-level metrics and per-route latency. Please share the team Slack channel you want alerts posted to and any PagerDuty escalation.

If acceptable, I'll prepare a short runbook entry and a lightweight Helm values snippet for your k8s ingress that toggles prefix routing during the ramp.

—Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Director, Customer Reliability — Redwood Inference

Thanks team. To make this operationally simple for PlatformOps, here's the proposed kickoff cadence and mutual action plan (MAP):

Week 0 (Now): staging smoke tests + run redwood-sdk sample
Week 1: 10% prefix cutover for 24h, monitor health dashboard
Week 2: 50% prefix cutover with canary certs, 48h observation
Week 3: 100% cutover + decommission VendorX routing if stable

Owners:
- Platform smoke tests: StellarPay (Liam)
- Cutover exec + rollback: Redwood On-call (Vivek)
- Customer communication + billing hold: Monica (CS)

Please confirm availability for a 30-minute kickoff on Monday 2026-12-07 at 11:00 PST. HubSpot MAP entry: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/STELL-2026-Q4-089
